reading: emit-only, same-apparatus delta on host DANIELDILLBERG: the frozen emit p99 6928 µs vs the GAUNTLET-1b candidate 5455 µs (1270 permille of frozen at p99). The candidate reproduced the frozen pixel witness (byte-identical — gate-enforced by gauntlet1-equiv / gauntlet1b-reduction, not by this record), and its floor loop does 2 divides/px where the frozen did 4 (1389296 floor divides removed on the witness frame). The promotion bar is the reader's: promote iff byte-identical AND the candidate emit p99 is strictly below the frozen emit's (speedup > 1000 permille); identical-but-not-faster is a correctness pass and a performance fail. This is an EMIT-level number, NOT the whole render, and NEVER compared to GAUNTLET-0's instrumented render absolute (a different apparatus). Witnesses were checked before any number was taken
